# Contributing

Thank you for your interest in Protectorate Core.

## Philosophy

We value:

- Readability
- Simplicity
- Security
- Consistency
- Documentation

## Before submitting code

- Test your changes.
- Keep commits focused.
- Update documentation when behavior changes.
- Follow the project style guide.

## Pull Requests

Every pull request should clearly describe:

- What changed
- Why it changed
- Any security implications
